rules.label: partial_range
rules.rest_note: Next set, try lowering until your elbows reach about a right angle.

rules.label: hip_sag
rules.rest_note: Your hips dipped on {n} reps. A straight line from shoulders to ankles keeps the effort in your chest and arms.

rules.label: incomplete_lockout
rules.rest_note: Your arms stopped short of straight at the top on {n} reps. Finishing with straight arms completes each rep.

rules.label: fast_lowering
rules.rest_note: Your reps took about {t} s on the way down. Around 2 s gives you more control.

knee.extra_note: A push-up puts little load on the knees. A folded mat under them makes the kneeling version more comfortable.

depth.rest_note: Next set, try lowering a little further, within a range that feels comfortable for your shoulder.

tempo.rest_note: Your reps took about {t} s on the way down. A slower 2 to 3 s is gentler on a recovering shoulder.

shoulder.extra_note: The depth here is set shorter to suit a recovering shoulder. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.

hip_sag.rest_note: Your hips dipped on {n} reps. A straight line from shoulders to ankles keeps the load off your lower back.

lower_back.extra_note: The hip line limit here is set tighter to go easy on a recovering lower back. Any pain is worth raising with your physio or a doctor.
